[ASSISTANT_SAID] - Korean BBQ Beef: 1 lb beef, 2 tbsp Gochujang, 2 tbsp soy sauce, 2 tbsp brown sugar, 2 tbsp garlic, 1 tsp grated ginger, 1 tsp sesame oil, 1 tsp Korean chili flakes, salt and black pepper.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - Kimchi Slaw: 2 cups kimchi, 1 cup shredded napa cabbage, 1/2 cup diced red bell pepper, 1/4 cup chopped cilantro, 2 tbsp lime juice, 1 tbsp fish sauce (optional), salt and pepper.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - Assembly and Toppings: Tortillas, sliced green onions, cilantro, lime wedges, Sriracha or hot sauce.
